rows.grounds: optative of kṛ, third person singular active
compound numeral phrase in instrumental case indicating count by which acts are performed

items.question: In what numerical order should the ritual acts be performed gradually after the homa and bali?
premises: Ritual acts follow homa and bali.
Their count descends five three two one.
items.inference: The practitioner should execute the remaining rites in descending numerical sequence.
uncertainties: Exact ritual referent of the counted acts is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Gradually, one should perform them by the number five, three, two, one.
